chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Nu'aym ibn Ibrahim, from 'Abbad ibn Kathir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who married off his mature son to an orphan girl under his guardianship. He said: 'He inherits her if she dies, and she does not inherit him if he dies, because she has the choice (of annulment) regarding him, but he has no choice regarding her.'

key_terms.وَلَا يَرِثُهَا: and she does not inherit him

ai.seo_question: What are the inheritance rules when a guardian marries his minor son to an orphan girl?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the asymmetry in inheritance rights arising from the legal concept of *khiyar al-bulugh* (option of maturity). The Imam explains that because the orphan girl retains the right to annul the marriage upon reaching maturity while the minor boy does not, she is not considered a permanent spouse for inheritance purposes if she dies before him, whereas he inherits from her as a valid spouse.
